name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.52-beta “Paris” (build 53): bundles for your submission.
• Bundle Exhibits asks which Word submission the bundle is for and ticks exactly the exhibits its List of Exhibits shows — not only the ones marked Included.
• The submission itself goes into the bundle as a PDF, straight from Word, with every citation linked to its exhibit. Choose Submission PDF… still lets you pick your own; × leaves it out.
• Links to files on your computer are removed from the linked submission — links within it and to the web stay.
